name: @crucibledx/forge-cli
description: AI development environment setup & config sync CLI

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/forge && bun run clean
scripts.test:human: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts -- e2e/commands/init.test.ts e2e/commands/config/ e2e/commands/source/ e2e/commands/uninstall.test.ts
scripts.test:security: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts -- src/infrastructure/fs/confinement.test.ts src/infrastructure/fs/transaction.test.ts src/application/commands/sync/safety.test.ts src/application/commands/sync/transaction.test.ts src/application/commands/sync/outcome.test.ts e2e/contracts/security.test.ts scripts/security-audit.test.ts
scripts.test:platform: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts -- src/infrastructure/fs/confinement.test.ts src/infrastructure/fs/transaction.test.ts src/infrastructure/fs/windows-access.test.ts src/application/commands/sync/safety.test.ts src/application/commands/sync/transaction.test.ts e2e/commands/sync/safety.test.ts e2e/contracts/platform.test.ts e2e/framework/contracts/pipe.test.ts
scripts.test:contracts: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts --timeout-ms 40000 -- scripts/ e2e/framework/contracts/ e2e/commands/sync/safety.test.ts e2e/contracts/
scripts.test: bun run scripts/run-tests.ts -- src/ e2e/ scripts/
